title: The efficacy of prophylactic antibiotic treatment on infectious complications in patients receiving CT-guided brachytherapy of liver
summary: The study objective is to determine the clinical and imaging risk factors for hepatic complications in the liver, and the effectiveness and safety of antibiotic prophylaxis in patients who underwent CT-guided brachytherapy.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients who underwent CT-guided brachytherapy in the interventional radiology.
Exclusion criteria:
missing data of brachytherapy
